sequence.question: Good morning! Walk me through your resume, highlighting the inflection points that shaped your interest in management consulting.
sequence.candidate_response_summary: Introduced engineering background, interest in data-backed decision making, and transition from pure coding to strategic problem solving during a startup internship.
follow_ups: What made you realize you wanted to solve client business problems rather than write code all day?
sequence.interviewer_reaction: Nodded, pivoted directly into fintech internship

sequence.question: In your FinTech internship, you wrote: 'Engineered an automated document parsing pipeline reducing verification turnaround time by 45%'. How was that 45% measured, and what was the baseline?
sequence.candidate_response_summary: Explained manual review took 22 minutes on average across 1,000 documents; automated pipeline cut it to 12 minutes.
follow_ups: What was the error rate of the automated model compared to human reviewers?
How did you convince operations to trust an automated pipeline with sensitive financial documents?
sequence.interviewer_reaction: Probed deeply into edge-case errors and operational change management

sequence.question: Let's pivot to a case. A premier nationwide supermarket chain in India has observed a 15% decline in operating profits over the past two quarters, despite stable overall footfall. How would you diagnose this?
sequence.candidate_response_summary: Structured profit into Revenue minus Costs. Clarified stable footfall meant either basket size dropped, product mix shifted to low-margin items, or operating costs increased. Asked for data on average basket value and gross margins.
follow_ups: Interesting. Average basket value actually remained unchanged, but gross margin dropped from 22% to 16%. Where would you look next?
Suppose the drop in margin is due to supply chain inflation in perishables. What 3 strategic levers would you recommend to the executive committee?
sequence.interviewer_reaction: Provided margin numbers only when candidate asked, tested structured synthesis

sequence.question: Accenture is helping enterprise clients deploy Generative AI. How would you explain the difference between fine-tuning a foundation model versus using a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture to a non-technical Chief Marketing Officer?
sequence.candidate_response_summary: Used an analogy: RAG is like an open-book exam where the model looks up latest company docs in real-time, whereas fine-tuning is like studying extensively before the exam to learn a specific style or jargon.
follow_ups: Under what client circumstances would fine-tuning be a waste of budget compared to RAG?
How would you address data privacy and hallucination risks for a banking client?
sequence.interviewer_reaction: Appreciated the clear business-friendly analogy, pushed on hallucination mitigation

sequence.question: Why Accenture Strategy & Consulting specifically over pure-play strategy firms, and tell me about a time you faced strong disagreement in a team deliverable.
sequence.candidate_response_summary: Highlighted Accenture's end-to-end transformation capability (strategy through technology execution). Described a disagreement in Inter-IIT team on task allocation, resolved by data-driven sub-deliverable benchmarks.
follow_ups: What did you learn about your own leadership style from that conflict?
sequence.interviewer_reaction: Satisfied with STAR structure, wrapped up and invited candidate questions

sequence.question: Tell me about your supply chain optimization project. What was the core business constraint you were trying to model?
sequence.candidate_response_summary: Explained inventory holding cost vs stockout penalty tradeoff for automotive spare parts.
follow_ups: How did you handle non-linear demand spikes during festival seasons?
What assumptions in your mathematical model would fail if deployed in a real Tier-2 Indian warehouse?
sequence.interviewer_reaction: Tested practical ground reality vs pure academic simulation

sequence.question: An oil marketing PSU in India wants to enter the EV fast-charging market along national highways. How would you estimate the market size and evaluate financial feasibility?
sequence.candidate_response_summary: Used top-down guesstimate on highway traffic, EV adoption curve (5% by 2027), average daily charging cycles, and power tariffs vs CAPEX of DC fast chargers.
follow_ups: What is the payback period if utilization is only 30% in year one?
What ancillary revenue streams can turn this charging hub into a profitable destination?
sequence.interviewer_reaction: Tested back-of-the-envelope calculation and commercial creativity

sequence.question: In consulting, clients often provide incomplete data and expect answers by Monday morning. Give me an example of how you navigated extreme ambiguity in your past work.
sequence.candidate_response_summary: Explained mentorship lead role during sudden curriculum overhaul with zero documentation, setting up peer crowdsourced FAQs.
follow_ups: How did you prioritize what was critical vs nice-to-have?
